errors.evidence: The last data points for both series are plotted at an x-value of 10, which corresponds to the last tick mark on the x-axis, not at x=11.
In the description of the 'mmsd' series, the final data point is incorrectly stated to be at x=11 when it is at x=10.
In the description of the 'mmsd2' series, the final data point is incorrectly stated to be at x=11 when it is at x=10.
The final accuracy for the 'mmsd2' series at x=10 is closer to 76.9% or 76.8%, as it is visibly just below the 77% line. 76.7% is a slightly low approximation.
The final data point for the 'mmsd' series at x=10 is exactly on the 80.0% grid line, making the approximation of 80.1% slightly inaccurate.
